query: How will we justify default impact thresholds (e.g., 1% / 0.5 dB)? Provide a sensitivity-analysis plan and method for adaptive per-family thresholds.

response.query: How will we justify default impact thresholds (e.g., 1% / 0.5 dB)? Provide a sensitivity-analysis plan and method for adaptive per-family thresholds.
response.answer: Default impact thresholds are justified through empirical data analysis and expert consensus. Sensitivity analysis will be conducted to assess threshold robustness. Adaptive per-family thresholds will be determined via iterative feedback and performance metrics.
